title: the cost a user sees is the cost they paid
description: Tasks: (1) Price table rows for claude-opus-5-5, claude-sonnet-5 at its current price and claude-fable-5-1 (cache read 0.25), with pricingAsOf and the source URL; the hook-side copy stays equal through pricing_divergences. (2) Print attribution coverage beside every cost-per-task figure (tasks with any attributed tokens / tasks done; main loop not attributed). (3) Pilot reading Claude Code's own costUSD or OTel cost instead of the plugin's table, and retire the table if it holds.
desiredOutcome: every cost the plugin prints uses current official prices with their date and source, and every per-task cost says how much of the work it actually attributes

tasks.title: pilot: compare Claude Code's own cost with the ledger's on the same work
tasks.description: Decide whether Claude Code's own cost can replace the plugin's price table. On the pinned CLI version, first verify which sources exist and at what grain (verifying-external-behavior): a headless run's total_cost_usd and modelUsage costUSD, the OTel claude_code.cost.usage metric with its agent.name attribute, and any per-message cost in the transcript meter-usage already tails; per-task attribution needs per-subagent cost, which a session total cannot give. Run one short headless session that spawns one subagent, capped with --max-budget-usd, with OTel exported to the console, and compare native cost per session and per agent with the ledger rows meter-usage wrote for it at the corrected table. Record the result as an evaluated entry in CONTRIBUTING.md's Decision record (the measurement as dated history with the command that re-derives it, and a revisit trigger). gate-only: a measurement and a written decision, no product code.

tasks.title: retire the shipped price table if the pilot shows native cost covers it
tasks.description: Only if the pilot's recorded decision says native cost holds at per-agent grain: meter-usage records Claude Code's own cost where the source carries it and keeps the table for rows without one (backfill of old transcripts), each row saying which priced it. COMPATIBILITY.md promises that a config key the plugin reads keeps being read, so usage.pricing stays honoured; retiring means the plugin stops maintaining shipped rows, not that it stops reading the key. If the pilot says it does not hold, close with /audit:task done --no-change --reason citing the Decision record entry. Rescope files and cases with /audit:task scope before starting, since the pilot decides the shape; risk is high because every cost the plugin prints and the Stop-hook path change.
